text:
**A.** Bill signed and delivered the deed, so it was a valid lifetime gift. Kathy took the condominium by survivorship as a tenant by the entirety, outside the will, and her prenuptial waiver doesn't affect that. I disagree with the team note for this question: in Florida a valid prenuptial waiver of "all rights" also bars the pretermitted-spouse share, so D fails and Tommy takes the pasture land while he and Julie split the residue.

CONFIDENCE: 85
